entities.summary: Gilbert Burnet was a Scottish philosopher and historian, and Bishop of Salisbury. He was fluent in Dutch, French, Latin, Greek, and Hebrew. Burnet was highly respected as a cleric, a preacher, an academic, a writer and a historian. He was always closely associated with the Whig party, and was one of the few close friends in whom King William III confided. Gilbert Burnet was a journalists & chroniclers from Edinburgh (1643-09-28, Edinburgh–1715-03-28). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
